label: slalom / reactive / seed 5
purpose: Actual closed-loop neural rollout from original-conditioned gait windows. Planner selects targets; model does not receive scene geometry.
limitations: Kinematic generation plus an external swept root-circle stop/slide controller; not a dynamic or limb collision solver.
Collision metrics use a conservative root proxy, not whole-body shape clearance.
A target is replanned every 0.5 seconds, and unused predicted futures are discarded.
Root radius 1.05 m is a conservative native-space broad-armor navigation envelope; full articulated collision is not solved.
Pursuit keeps a larger arrival standoff; mutual dynamic cat/actor collision is not solved.
C08/BREK grounding is a separate displayed retarget correction; raw G1 is retained.
